matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades in the 68th percentile against a unit that grades 42nd — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about this Jacksonville matchup: we've got the widest real statistical edge of any game on the board this week, and it's in our wheelhouse — a rushing offense in the 68th percentile against a run defense that grades 42nd. That's the kind of advantage you have to cash in on. But Jacksonville's offense still grades in the top ten, and we're coming off a game where we made clock management decisions that had our own coaches shaking their heads, which feels like something the Jaguars will absolutely punish. The good news is we're favored on the road; the complicated news is our last trip to Jacksonville was a disaster just two years ago, and these aren't the same Jaguars teams we handled in 2021 and 2015. This one's winnable if we execute the gameplan — especially on the ground — but Jacksonville's clearly counting on us to look the way they say we do: still finding ourselves.
